title: Jimmy Gilbert speaks about God with raw and soulful new single “Walking with The Lord”
htmlContent: In a world where polished production often takes center stage, Jimmy Gilbert strips it back with his latest single, “Walking with The Lord.” Recorded in his home studio with his equipment, Jimmy leans into the power of authenticity, capturing the song in mostly one take, free from excessive effects or studio trickery. “Walking with The Lord” carries the same storytelling warmth that fans of Zach Bryan, Noah Kahan, and Sam Barber will appreciate. Jimmy is carving his own space in the genre, bringing music that speaks about God to a scene that thrives on raw, heartfelt expression. His approach is unfiltered, allowing the emotion in his voice and the sincerity of his message to take the lead. https://open.spotify.com/track/5tW4znFw3IdgJvbD8OrfhA?si=KIMLLDM_SgSXP0JvjR7aZA Jimmy’s vocals shine against a backdrop of acoustic richness, pulling listeners into an intimate moment of reflection and devotion. As mainstream folk continue to embrace honesty and vulnerability, “Walking with The Lord” is a universal reminder that faith is most powerful when it’s real.
